item.title: Longtime ABC7 News reporter Jim Vargas dies at 78, family says
item.description: Former ABC7 News reporter Jim Vargas has died, his family announced. He was 78 years old. A Bay Area native, Vargas' journalism career spanned more than 40 years. He worked for 20 years at ABC7 covering politics and public affairs until 1993.

item.title: Here's the potential impact a proposed CA billionaire tax could have on Silicon Valley
item.description: A proposed tax on California billionaires is shaking Silicon Valley, with some tech leaders warning they will leave the state if it passes. Here are the potential impacts.

item.title: Europe warns of 'dangerous downward spiral' after Trump threatens tariffs over Greenland
item.description: The eight European countries targeted by President Trump for a 10% tariff for opposing American control of Greenland blasted the move.

item.title: Several people injured, including child, after car crashes into SF church, authorities say
item.description: A car slammed into a church on Sunday in San Francisco injuring seven people, including a child, firefighters said.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Mostly sunny, mild afternoons ahead this week
item.description: The next few days will bring us a continuing pattern of partly-to-mostly sunny and mild afternoons, with high temperatures in the mid-to-upper 60s from the coast to the bay to inland.

item.title: Green Day to open 60th Super Bowl with anniversary ceremony celebrating generations of MVPs
item.description: Green Day will kick off the 60th Super Bowl with an opening ceremony at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, California.

item.title: San Francisco kicks off Lunar New Year celebrations, supporting small businesses
item.description: Lunar New Year celebrations kicked off on San Francisco's Commercial Street Saturday with the launch of new market supporting Chinatown businesses.

item.title: PG&E planned outages in SF for substation repairs this week forcing some businesses to close
item.description: San Francisco PG&E customers are bracing for two planned power outages this week. Local businesses affected by the outages are also preparing for another dip in customers and revenue.

item.title: Beloved 'Claude' the albino alligator honored with street renaming at Golden Gate Park
item.description: On Sunday, hundreds of people gathered in Golden Gate Park to celebrate the life and legacy of a San Francisco icon. The California Academy of Sciences honored Claude, the beloved albino alligator.

item.title: Protestors in SF demand regime change in Iran while honoring the thousands of lives lost
item.description: Protestors from across the Bay Area gathered Sunday afternoon in front of San Francisco's Ferry Building, demanding regime change in Iran after thousands of protesters have been reportedly killed over the past several weeks of uprising.
